projects.title: Bandersnatch
projects.description:
As part of the final project for graduation, this project required us to work on an existing application and take on various tickets to simulate a real work environment. The main purpose of the application was to visualize fictitious 'monsters' with various stats and predict different target variables based on other features. The monsters were randomly generated using the MonsterLab Python package.

My contribution included: 
- Developing the database interface class to manage the CRUD operations in MongoDB.
- Building and testing different ML models to predict the 'Rarity' of monsters and deploying the best model.
- Creating dynamic visualizations to display the monsters based on user inputs.
